subject: learning/draft-ranked-priority
statement: Draft readiness recognizes the leading Must priority class when the PRD template adds a rank, so ranked Must requirements retain mandatory design coverage and fit-criterion verification.
rationale: The scripted authoring fixture emitted the template-supported Must (rank 1) form. Comparing the entire cell to Must allowed an unserved requirement to pass readiness and classified its missing fit criteria as non-Must. Read the class without changing the literal row.
fit_criterion: TestRankedMustRequirementsHoldReadiness compiles ranked rows and refuses missing serving decisions, fit criteria, and verification under FR-13 and FR-14.
